name: DJI Pocket 3 - Pocket-Sized Gimbal Camera with 1-Inch Sensor
short_description: Pocket-sized handheld camera with 3-axis mechanical gimbal and 1-inch CMOS sensor. 4K/120fps recording with a rotatable 2-inch touchscreen. The world’s smallest 1-inch sensor gimbal camera.

name: Roborock S8 MaxV Ultra - Smart Robot Vacuum with 10,000Pa Suction
short_description: Robot vacuum and mop with 10,000Pa suction power. Self-maintaining dock washes, dries, refills water, and empties dust automatically. AI camera obstacle avoidance. Home Assistant compatible.

name: FIMI X8 Mini V2 - 4K Drone at 245g with Competitive Pricing
short_description: Lightweight drone (245g) with 4K/30fps camera and 3-axis mechanical gimbal. 31-minute flight time and 9km range. Excellent budget alternative to DJI Mini.

name: Insta360 X4 - 8K 360-Degree Camera
short_description: 360-degree camera with 8K/30fps and 5.7K/60fps recording. 2290mAh battery lasting 135 minutes. Waterproof to 10 meters. AI-powered auto-reframing for effortless editing.

name: DJI RS 4 - 3-Axis Gimbal Stabilizer for Professional Cameras
short_description: 3-axis gimbal supporting cameras up to 3kg. 13.5-hour battery with fast charging. Bluetooth control and intelligent tracking. Perfect for filmmakers and content creators.

name: DJI Osmo Action 5 Pro - 4K/120fps Waterproof Action Camera
short_description: Action camera with 1/1.3-inch sensor and 4K/120fps recording. Waterproof to 20m without a case. 4-hour battery life with RockSteady 3.0 stabilization. Direct GoPro Hero competitor.

name: DJI Avata 2 - Immersive FPV Drone with Goggles
short_description: Immersive FPV drone with 4K/60fps camera and 1/1.7-inch sensor. Includes DJI Goggles 3 and motion controller. First-person flying experience like no other. Weighs 377g.

name: DJI Mini 4 Pro - Sub-249g Drone with 4K/60fps Camera
short_description: Lightweight drone (under 249g) with 4K/60fps camera and 1/1.3-inch CMOS sensor. Omnidirectional obstacle avoidance in all directions. Up to 34 minutes flight time. No registration required in most countries.
